   - Added a new test case to verify that phrase field queries spanning multiple fields are correctly handled within their own dismax queries.

- The changes in `ExtendedDismaxQParser.java` directly address the bug reported in SOLR-6062 by modifying how phrase queries are constructed and merged, ensuring that they are processed correctly based on their word grams and slop values.
